popCulture.title: Asteropaios
popCulture.description: Paeonian spearman, son of the river Axius — Homer's two-handed fighter whom Achilles kills beside the Scamander.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book 21 stages Asteropaeus' duel with Achilles in the river battle — the Paeonian captain's lasting epic scene.
